spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Which device is filling the Internet line, with what, and to where?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/network/architecture.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Download now
spec.description:
Everything the Internet line is receiving, from the router's own counters.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Upload now
spec.description:
Everything the line is sending. Upload is the narrow direction: a full upload delays every device's traffic, downloads included.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Devices on the line
spec.description:
Devices with any Internet traffic in the last two minutes. Flow export covers what the router forwards to the Internet; a device's name comes from its DHCP lease, else its address.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Download attributed
spec.description:
Share of the line's download that flow export puts a device to. Well under 100% means flows are missing (exporter, relay or collector), so the device lists undercount.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Top downloaders now

defaults.noValue: No traffic seen by flow export

spec.description:
The ten devices downloading most right now. Click a row to follow that device below.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Top uploaders now

defaults.noValue: No traffic seen by flow export

spec.description:
The ten devices uploading most right now: the usual cause when latency climbs for everyone (backups, cameras, cloud sync).

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Data in range by device
spec.description:
Bytes each device moved over the selected range, both directions, most first.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Download by device
spec.description:
Download per picked device over time.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Upload by device
spec.description:
Upload per picked device over time. Line it up with the latency beside it.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Internet latency
spec.description:
p90 round trip to Internet targets. A rise that tracks one device's upload is that device filling the line (bufferbloat).

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Now: device, app and destination

spec.expr: label_replace(topk(15, sum by (client, app, as_name) (label_replace(wan:client_app_receive_bits:rate2m, "direction", "down", "", "") or label_replace(wan:client_app_transmit_bits:rate2m, "direction", "up", "", ""))), "as_name", "$1", "as_name", "(?:- )?(.+)")

defaults.noValue: No traffic seen by flow export

spec.description:
The fifteen busiest device, app and remote-network combinations right now, both directions. Apps are guessed from ports and networks, so read them as a hint.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Data in range by destination
spec.description:
Bytes to and from each remote network (by its owner, from the ASN) over the selected range.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Traffic by app
spec.description:
Both directions per app for the picked devices.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Traffic by destination
spec.description:
Both directions to the ten busiest remote networks at each moment, for the picked devices.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
